blocks.text: Written by: Annelle Tayao-Juego Filipino investors will soon be able to buy into a new stock offering from property developer Arthaland Corporation using the GCash app, as the company opens its Series G and H preferred shares to the public from September 14 to 25. The shares, priced at P500 each, will be available through GStocks PH, an investment feature within GCash operated by broker AB Capital Securities Inc. Series G shares carry an annual dividend rate of 7.3 percent, while Series H offers 7.8 percent, both subject to the terms of the offering. Preferred shares differ from ordinary stock: They […]...
